card.name: Salt endings in drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a drug's salt name, mostly "ate" completing "Maleate" and "ide" completing "Hydrochloride". It fires when the name is capitalized and followed by Tablets or Injection.

modes.label: Maleate ending
modes.description: The "ate" that finishes "Maleate" after a drug name such as Fluvoxamine, Timolol or Brompheniramine.
